name: dev.mossforge/databroker
description: Pay-per-call UK MOT history, reliability analytics and identifier utilities. x402 USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the DataBroker API, e.g. https://api.databroker.mossforge.dev
environmentVariables.name: DATABROKER_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Signer provider: "raw" (default, self-custodied private key) or "cdp" (Coinbase CDP-managed wallet)
environmentVariables.name: DATABROKER_SIGNER

environmentVariables.description: 0x-prefixed private key for the paying wallet. Required when DATABROKER_SIGNER=raw (the default).
environmentVariables.name: DATABROKER_WALLET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key id. Required when DATABROKER_SIGNER=cdp.
environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key secret. Required when DATABROKER_SIGNER=cdp.
environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP wallet secret. Required when DATABROKER_SIGNER=cdp.
environmentVariables.name: CDP_WALLET_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Per-call spend cap in USDC. Calls priced above this are declined before payment.
environmentVariables.name: DATABROKER_MAX_USDC
